title: Cursory
summary: CURSORY, adjective [Latin See Course.] 1. Running; hasty; slight; superficial; careless; not with close attention; as a cursory reading; a cursory view. 2. Running about; not stationary.

inlines.v: CURSORY, adjective [Latin See Course.] 1. Running; hasty; slight; superficial; careless; not with close attention; as a cursory reading; a cursory view. 2. Running about; not stationary.
